title: Dukes of Duchesca - Napoli '97
name: dukesofduchesca-napoli97
summary: Napoli, summer 1997: from the Rock Garden to the party on the Gaiola beach in a Fiat 500. Eight items to find, scooter gangs to shake off, and the police to drive past slowly.
description: The night starts outside the Rock Garden, the rock club of Via San Giovanni Maggiore Pignatelli, a few doors from the Rettifilo and a short drive from the Duchesca. Drive a pimped-up white Fiat 500 across a Napoli drawn from memory of a city atlas: the Posillipo promontory, Mergellina and Via Caracciolo, Castel dell'Ovo, the tight grid of the centro storico, the Rettifilo, the station, Capodimonte and Capodichino, with its monuments standing where you expect them: Piazza del Plebiscito, Palazzo Reale, Maschio Angioino, Castel dell'Ovo, Castel Sant'Elmo, the Duomo, the Museo Nazionale, the Stadio San Paolo, the Stazione Centrale. Collect the eight things no party can do without, thread through the traffic of cars and orange city buses, refuel before the tank runs dry, shake off the scooter gangs with the horn or a lit rauto, stay near the police patrols the scooters are afraid of, but lift off when you pass them and at every posto di blocco, or you will be chased, halted and searched, and the rauti and some of the gear may be confiscated, and reach the beach of the Gaiola under Capo Posillipo, where the summer nights of the 1990s ended, facing the two islets and their little bridge. The game closes with everybody dancing on the sand before the night is over. Palette-indexed graphics with exact colours on the ESP32-C6, a sunset that turns into night as you play, and an original four-track SID-like soundtrack that speeds up when you are being chased, with stereo-panned effects.
controls: D-Pad: point where to go, the car turns and accelerates; let go to slow down. A: horn (scares scooters). B: light a rauto (banger). START: pause.
content_notice: Freely inspired by a 1980s television car-chase series; not affiliated with its rights holders. Code, art and music are original.
